The files give the SAMPL9 WP6 host (a carboxylated pillar[6]arene; host file shown with 12 carboxylates) and four candidate guests as 3D structures (XYZ, angstrom). Binding to WP6 was measured by isothermal titration calorimetry in 1× PBS at pH 7.40 and 298.15 K; all complexes are 1:1. You start from guest G13 (1-methyl-4-(1-methylpyridin-1-ium-4-yl)pyridin-1-ium), whose measured binding free energy to WP6 under these conditions is -8.47 kcal/mol, and want a replacement guest that binds WP6 at least 1.8 kcal/mol more strongly (measured ΔG ≤ -10.27 kcal/mol). Exactly one of the four candidates achieves this in the measured data. Which one?

选项：
A. G6: cyclooctylammonium (WP6-G6.xyz)
B. G10: trimethyl-[[4-[(trimethylammonio)methyl]phenyl]methyl]ammonium (WP6-G10.xyz)
C. G12: trimethyl-[6-(trimethylammonio)-2-adamantyl]ammonium (WP6-G12.xyz)
D. G5: [3,5-dimethyl-7-(trimethylammonio)-1-adamantyl]-trimethyl-ammonium (WP6-G5.xyz)

附件：WP6.xyz、WP6-G12.xyz、WP6-G10.xyz、WP6-G5.xyz、WP6-G6.xyz（均为本题完整输入）。范围：主体与客体为 SAMPL9 提供的 3D 结构；答案依据实测 ITC 结合自由能（1× PBS，pH 7.40，298.15 K，1:1），证据只在审核侧。 只回答一个字母 A、B、C 或 D。
